1418-2226-6844.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1418-2226-6844.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Spider-Man 2099 by paying its mana cost.
When Spider-Man 2099 enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

413-549-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
413-549-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the creature's trigger, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 5.
413-549-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

2438-4772-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2438-4772-5254.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.

522-5256--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

413-2738-4871-6026.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Field of Souls, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token.
When the token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 6.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Tenacious Dead enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1322-2590-5776-7313.description:
Activate another creature you control, which is a Food due to Ygra, by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Ygra and Experimental Confectioner trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-5702--143.manaNeeded: {2}{G} plus enough mana to animate the land
4094-5702--143.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a land that doesn't have summoning sickness and that can tap to produce at least {G}.
4094-5702--143.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Earthbend a land that can tap to produce at least {G}, thus animating it.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated land.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the land it is attached to due to Kaya, Geist Hunter.
When the land tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the two land tokens by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and create two 1/1 Insect creature tokens due to Kaya, Geist Hunter
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the land it is attached to due to Kaya, Geist Hunter.
Repeat from step 6.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 6 or greater

215-539-7488-7781.description:
Activate Topiary Lecturer by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, untapping Topiary Lecturer
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4659-5003-5004.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
Cathodion and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Cathodion from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

1636-2438-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Belonging trigger, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
When the Shapeshifters enter, Intruder Alarm triggers three times. Resolve the Intruder Alarm triggers from this step and step 2, untapping all creatures four times.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Belonging.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

423-1437-5233-5478.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-5233-5478.description:
Cast Spelunking by paying {2}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Spelunking spell three times.
Resolve the first Spelunking copy.
The Spelunking token enters the battlefield, drawing a card then putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield untapped.
Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
In response, activate the land by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
423-1437-5233-5478.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Spelunking. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

2919-4659-5086-5183-6291.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2919-4659-5086-5183-6291.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

803-1399-1606-6984.notablePrerequisites:
Evendo has at least twelve charge counters on it.
You control at least three creatures.
803-1399-1606-6984.description:
Activate Evendo by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Evendo.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat

1170-1329-1492-6633.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-6633.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3532-4985-5078-5402.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4985-5078-5402.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

132-2645-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Clues if Staff of Domination is exiled, or five Clues otherwise.
132-2645-5527.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Five Hundred Year Diary's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
If Staff of Domination is exiled, activate Myr Welder using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Otherwise, activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Myr Welder. Then, activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
132-2645-5527.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Staff of Domination's other abilities.

2034-2092-6873.description:
Activate Fire Nation Archers by paying {1}, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and creating a 2/2 Soldier creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat
2034-2092-6873.notes: You can skip step 2 each other iteration if desired.

1563-2457-3000-4885.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

186-2034-3862-4013.easyPrerequisites: You do not control an Army.
186-2034-3862-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {1}{C}, blinking Orcish Bowmasters.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target and creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Orc Army, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

186-1741-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}.
186-1741-4499.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {2}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

1308-2793-3743-4067-5089.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
1308-2793-3743-4067-5089.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

372-1018-1922.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Blur exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1018-1922.description:
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Skullwinder and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Skullwinder trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Blur from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Blur.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Skullwinder and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1017-1242-1656-4971.notablePrerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1017-1242-1656-4971.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Niv-Mizzet's ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Necrotic Ooze.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

1651-1737-3281-3459.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0}, creating a token copy of Great Furnace.
When the Great Furnace token enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Battered Golem and the Great Furnace token, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

1339-3265-4365-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-3265-4365-4871.description:
Activate Dockside Chef by paying {1}{B} and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Dockside Chef ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

678-2929-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You have an enchantment creature card in hand.
You control at least six enchantments.
You have enough mana to cast the enchantment creature.
678-2929-4050.description:
Cast the enchantment creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Composer of Spring triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the enchantment creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the enchantment creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the enchantment creature to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Composer of Spring trigger from step 2, putting the enchantment creature onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

671-1424-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Presence of Gond attached to Famished Paladin.
671-1424-3957.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create a 1/1 creature token.
The token ETBs, triggering Daxos and gaining you 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.
